welle_k4.frage: What does Turkey demand, and what can {land} bear?
welle_k4.antwort.nein: {land} refuses: {n, plural, one {one point} other {# points}} over budget. It will then table a counter-offer.
welle_k4.antwort.sperre: {land} refuses: one demand is not negotiable for {land}.
welle_k4.budget.rechnung: How the budget is made up
welle_k4.budget.kontrolle: Share of the target area held
welle_k4.form.zone.name: Zone
welle_k4.form.zone.text: The region stays under Turkish control as a security zone; the border stays where it is.
welle_k4.form.zone_umk.text: The enemy withdraws from the contested region and it becomes a security zone. This costs more than a region already held.
welle_k4.form.satellit.name: Special status
welle_k4.form.satellit.text: A separate administration under Turkish protection, with a security zone and a joint commission. Dearer than a zone and barely recognised abroad.
welle_k4.form.annexion.name: Cession
welle_k4.form.annexion.text: The enemy cedes the region by treaty, as France did with Hatay in 1939. A state only does this when it is finished.
welle_k4.form.rueckgabe.name: Return
welle_k4.form.rueckgabe.text: Turkey hands the region over within three weeks. This makes other demands easier but costs at home.
welle_k4.form.verzicht.name: Waive
welle_k4.form.verzicht.text: Turkey does not demand the contested region; it stays with the enemy.
welle_k4.grund.umkaempft: Only regions Turkey holds can receive special status or be ceded.
welle_k4.grund.hauptstadt: {land} will not give up its capital.
welle_k4.grund.druck: {land} cedes no territory unless it is finished: support at {uhr} or below, or in retreat.
welle_k4.grund.sonderstatus: {land} grants no special status until it is clearly exhausted: support at {uhr} or below.
welle_k4.auflage.patrouillen.text: With {mit}, 10 km deep on both sides of the zone. Makes the package easier for {land} to accept.
welle_k4.auflage.rueckkehr.text: Safe and voluntary return into the zone. Popular at home.
welle_k4.auflage.reparation.text: {land} pays for the damage. Brings money, costs trust.
welle_k4.auflage.garantien.text: A demilitarised border and security guarantees, as in the Adana Agreement.
welle_k4.weg.vorbild.USA: like Pence and Erdoğan on 17 Oct 2019
welle_k4.weg.vorbild.RUS: like the Sochi memorandum of 22 Oct 2019
welle_k4.weg.bonus.RUS: Moscow guarantees it, Washington resents it
welle_k4.paket.tisch.text: The president's package from the peace table.
welle_k4.paket.gegen.text: The other side's counter-offer from the peace table.
welle_k4.paket.vermittler.text: The mediator's package from the peace table.
welle_k4.fr.abtretung: {n, plural, one {one region} other {# regions}} ceded by treaty
welle_k4.fr.satellit: {n, plural, one {one region} other {# regions}} with special status
welle_k4.fr.rueckgabe: {n, plural, one {one region goes} other {# regions go}} back within {tage} days
welle_k4.uebergabe.warum: The peace treaty provided for its return by a deadline.
welle_k4.x.kein_tisch: There is no peace table at the moment.
welle_k4.x.keine_region: This region is not on the table.
welle_k4.x.kein_paket: This package is not on the table.
welle_k4.x.abgelehnt: {land} refuses: {zuviel, plural, one {one point} other {# points}} more than it can bear.
welle_k4.x.abgelehnt_sperre: {land} refuses: one demand is not negotiable.
welle_k4.x.abgelehnt.warum: {land} tables a counter-offer worth {punkte} points. Tension rises.
krieg.besatzung.form.zone.name: Security zone
krieg.besatzung.form.zone.text: Secured militarily under the peace treaty, barely administered; tolerated abroad, not recognised.
krieg.besatzung.form.satellit.name: Special status
krieg.besatzung.form.satellit.text: A separate administration under Turkish protection under the peace treaty; barely recognised abroad.
krieg.besatzung.form.zivil.name: Civil administration
krieg.besatzung.form.zivil.text: Schools, power, water and courts run through the border provinces: expensive, but resistance falls.
krieg.besatzung.form.rueckgabe.name: Handover
krieg.besatzung.form.rueckgabe.text: The peace treaty returns the region; the handover is under way.
